description: Autogrowth/shrink from default trace (24h): event counts, grown MB, duration, hotspots, plus file growth config risks (percent growth, tiny increments, near max size).

targets.expr: sum(mssql_autogrowth_total_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) or vector(0)
count(mssql_autogrowth_total_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} > 0) or vector(0)
sum(mssql_autogrowth_events_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}", event_type="data_growth"}) or vector(0)
sum(mssql_autogrowth_events_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}", event_type="log_growth"}) or vector(0)

(sum(mssql_autogrowth_shrink_total_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) or sum(mssql_autogrowth_events_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}", event_type=~"data_shrink|log_shrink"}) or vector(0))
count(mssql_autogrowth_events_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}"} > 50) or vector(0)

sum(mssql_autogrowth_growth_mb_total_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) or sum(mssql_autogrowth_growth_mb_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}"}) or vector(0)
max(mssql_autogrowth_max_duration_ms_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}"}) or vector(0)
max by (instance, db, file_name, event_type) (mssql_autogrowth_events_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}"} > 0)
max by (instance, db, file_name, event_type) (mssql_autogrowth_last_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}"})
max by (instance, db, file_name, event_type) (mssql_autogrowth_growth_mb_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}"})
max by (instance, db, file_name, event_type) (mssql_autogrowth_max_duration_ms_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}"})
max by (instance, db, file_name, event_type) (mssql_autogrowth_avg_duration_ms_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}"})
topk(15, sum by (instance) (mssql_autogrowth_total_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}))
sum by (instance, event_type) (mssql_autogrowth_events_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}"})
mssql_autogrowth_growth_mb_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}"}
topk(20, sum by (instance, db) (mssql_autogrowth_events_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}"}))
mssql_autogrowth_max_duration_ms_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}"}
sum by (instance, db) (mssql_autogrowth_events_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}", event_type=~"data_growth|log_growth"})
sum by (instance, db) (mssql_autogrowth_events_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}", event_type="data_growth"})
sum by (instance, db) (mssql_autogrowth_events_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}", event_type="log_growth"})
sum by (instance, db) (mssql_autogrowth_events_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}", event_type=~"data_shrink|log_shrink"})
sum by (instance, db) (mssql_autogrowth_growth_mb_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type=~"${event_type:regex}"})
mssql_database_space_is_percent_growth{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} == 1

mssql_database_space_growth_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} > 0 < 64 unless on(instance, db, file_id, logical_name, type_desc, physical_name) (mssql_database_space_is_percent_growth{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} == 1)

panels.title: Tiny Fixed Growth (<64 MB) - frequent autogrowth risk

targets.expr: mssql_database_space_pct_of_max{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= 85

panels.title: Near Max Size (>=85%) - autogrowth may fail soon

targets.expr: mssql_database_space_growth_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"}

title: Collector autogrowth
